name: Premium Voice Service SLA
description: SLA for premium voice call services with strict quality guarantees

rules.name: Intra-Network Call Connection Time
rules.description: No more than 3 seconds to connect and ring destination number from same network

conditions.description: Connection time must be 3 seconds or less

rules.name: Daily Dropped Calls Limit (Good Signal)
rules.description: No more than 3 network caused dropped calls per day on 4 bar signal strength and up

conditions.description: Maximum 3 dropped calls per day with strong signal (4+ bars)

rules.name: Call Connection Success Rate
rules.description: No more than 1 failed call connect attempt for every 10 outgoing call attempts

conditions.description: Failure rate must be 10% or less (1 in 10 calls)
